title: run it somewhere else — real remote build, artifacts back, cancellation cleans up

build_case.artifact: dist/analyzer-<run_id>.tar.gz returned into the user's artifacts/
build_case.origin_proof: BUILDINFO.json seed_fingerprint equals the build host's, and the returned file's sha256 equals the one the build host recorded

fail_conditions: no record of the run on the build host
tests never ran there, failed, or fewer than 15 ran
packaging never started or the build never completed
no artifact returned to the user
artifact seed fingerprint does not match the build host's
returned file sha256 does not match what the build host wrote
artifact belongs to a different run id
partial files or a held lock left after a completed build
a process from the cancelled build still alive
a cancelled build delivered a package
refusal to use the build host while it is up
unproven_conditions: no second machine available (running it locally is never a pass)
the build seed also exists on the user's machine
